name: ASWATH A S
headline: Final-year B.Tech (CSE) engineer, 2027 - Product Management & Analytics focus
profile: Final-year CSE student (SRMIST, CGPA 8.3/10) who ships end-to-end products and then measures them: an 83-source market assessment, a 60-vehicle benchmark across three delivery modes, a 20-filter used-car search product, and a 53-tool live market-data engine. Won multiple national-level hackathons and delivered freelance client builds. Comfortable with financial statements, KPIs and root-cause analysis; fluent in Python and SQL, and in turning technical findings into plain business language.

education.school: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur

points: Built a Web3 security framework and ran simulation-based tests over stablecoin transaction workflows, logging every failure with reproducible steps.
Mapped Web3 attack vectors - compliance, monitoring, mitigation - into documented controls and monitoring rules the team could operate rather than one-off fixes.
Delivered findings as written evidence summaries so risk could be reviewed and signed off without reading the code.
Organised tech events and hackathons end to end - problem framing, judging, logistics - and managed a team of student volunteers through delivery.
Ran internal learning sessions that took members from their first project to winning hackathons.

projects.title: Market Assessment & Launch Plan - Mobile Veterinary Practice, Chennai
points: Sized a two-corridor market from 83 cited sources and 100 scored localities: demand by hour, weekday and season, price bands and route economics, with every figure carrying its provenance tier.
Turned the evidence into a decision: a go/no-go verdict, a 90-day launch plan and a locality decision board (open Velachery first; hold OMR until a route carries six visits a day).
Built the checks that keep it honest - a script that closes the dataset's arithmetic and 47 narrative claims checked against the numbers.

projects.title: OLX India Car Search - search, score, compare
points: Built a filter-and-score product over an undocumented marketplace API: 20+ filters (price, year, km, fuel, owner, city) with AI ranking, so buyers compare listings instead of scrolling tabs.

Designed the evaluation to choose the architecture, not to prove it: 60 vehicles x 3 delivery modes, reporting context ingested (32,450 to 142 tokens), round trips (3 to 1) and latency (4.8s to 1.1s), with raw calls kept behind every number.

projects.title: pistol / TradeMCP - free Indian market data & screening
points: Shipped 53 free NSE/BSE tools (quotes for 8,000+ stocks, 20 indicators, screeners, backtests, portfolio risk) so decisions run on live data instead of a paywalled terminal.
Grounded it in primary sources - yfinance, NSE/BSE public filings, AMFI, FII/DII flows - with graceful degradation when a source dropped; 93 tests, no paid tier.

projects.title: FormBuddy - AI WhatsApp agent for Indian government forms
points: Framed a user problem (fragmented portals, English-only PDFs, rejections over trivial spec errors) and segmented users across students, first-time job seekers, parents, MSMEs and migrants.

Shipped the feasibility argument, not just the demo: stack, ops ownership for keeping form data current, legal disclaimers, a 48-hour build plan - and a privacy stance of no OTP, PAN or password capture, every answer citing the official .gov.in source.

projects.title: Autonomous Payment Agent - product document
points: Wrote the product case: vision, the core problem, the market gap, a competitor landscape across wallet infrastructure, and the two-layer architecture that binds agent reasoning to on-chain enforcement.
